# Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum

> > Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum (Tobikan) is a major public art museum in Ueno Park, Tokyo, celebrating its 100th anniversary with diverse exhibitions and educational programs.

The museum features rotating exhibitions of contemporary and classical art, collaborates with institutions like Tokyo University of the Arts, and runs community engagement initiatives including the Tobira Project and Museum Start i-Ueno. Located in Ueno Park, it serves as a cultural hub for art education and accessibility.
